name: @playform/ets-hook-dsh-edit-suggester
description: The edit-suggester hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that hooks the tools/post-execute waterfall and, when a modification call (write, edit, raw-write) lands on a file whose family carries a STANDARD COMPANION SET (the version lives in 36 manifests, 6 Apply.ts and the CHANGELOG; a Config.ts edit must also land in the README's Config section, SCHEME.md, the cordis.patch.yml row and the byte-exact test), prepends ONE labeled additionalContexts note naming the companions the model has not touched yet - the second consumer of the search-suggester's pattern algebra, owning the modification intent the search consumer deliberately refuses (Documentation/Plans/SEARCH-SUGGESTER-PLUGIN.md sections 8.4 and 1.4: the edit is where the discovery happens). Deterministic path rules, a hard gate, a cooldown, a dedupe, a per-turn cap, and an abstention line for every silence.
